title: My Skin
description: Upload custom skins and capes with a simple click that sync across all players on any Fabric server
body:
Upload custom skins and capes with a simple click that sync across all players on any Fabric server

_(It must be installed on server)_

## How does it work? 
Left Mouse Click - choose skin 
Right Mouse Click - change model type (wide or slim) 
Shift + Left Mouse Click - choos cape
